fullDescription: A high-alert, vibrant emergency monitoring dashboard designed for real-time data visualization. Featuring a deep dark background (#0a0608) with electric red (#ff2d55) and orange (#ff6a00) accents, this design uses a 'seismic grid' background and cinematic scanline animations. It is suitable for disaster response, cybersecurity, fintech risk management, or live server monitoring. The aesthetic balances editorial typography (Clash Grotesk) with technical data displays and pulse-based micro-interactions to signify urgency.

structured.summary: A high-energy, dark-mode emergency dashboard utilizing red/orange gradients, seismic-style grid backgrounds, and real-time pulse animations to monitor active threats and regional statuses.

style.description: The style is 'Tactical Vibrant.' It pairs high-contrast neon accents with a deep obsidian base. Typography utilizes 'Clash Grotesk' for bold, technical headers and 'Satoshi' for legible body text. Visual depth is achieved through radial glow gradients, subtle seismic grid lines (28px size), and CSS scanline flickers. Interactive elements feature heavy glows, 'hot' borders, and staggered fade-up entrance animations.
style.prompt: Create a high-contrast dark theme dashboard with a background color of #0a0608. Use a subtle background pattern of 28px square seismic grid lines in rgba(255,45,85,0.04). Primary typography: 'Clash Grotesk' (700 weight for headers), Secondary typography: 'Satoshi' (Regular/Medium/Bold). Primary Color: #ff2d55 (Red); Secondary: #ff6a00 (Orange); Muted Text: #6b3345. Implement a horizontal scanline animation that travels vertically every 6 seconds. Apply a staggered fade-up animation (translateY: 18px to 0, opacity: 0 to 1) to all page sections. Text gradients should follow a 110-degree angle from #ff2d55 to #ff6a00. Card containers use #130b0e with a 1px border of #2e1520 and 16px corner radius.

layout_and_structure.description: The layout is a single-column mobile-first dashboard that prioritizes real-time status at the top, followed by interactive stats, urgent alerts, and a vertical activity log. It includes a persistent bottom navigation bar.

prompts.prompt: Create a sticky header with a top-aligned neon 'hot line' (2px height, #ff2d55 glow). Include a left-aligned profile section with a 36x36px logo icon (red-orange gradient) and a greeting in Satoshi 18px. On the right, place a 40x40px dark-card notification bell with a red #ff2d55 blinking dot badge.

Design a status bar with background: rgba(255,45,85,0.1) and a 1px border. Feature a 'live pulse' icon using three concentric ripple rings (2.2s ease-out animation) and bold uppercase text: '2 ACTIVE ALERTS — REGION'.

A horizontal scrolling row of stat cards (110px min-width). The most critical card should use a 'hot' gradient border (rgba(255,45,85,0.3)). Each card features a Lucide icon, a category label in 10px uppercase, and a large 30px Clash Grotesk value. Use different accent colors for each stat: Red for Alerts, Blue for Signal, Green for Regions.

A vertical stack of high-urgency cards. HIGH alert cards: background linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,45,85,0.14), rgba(255,45,85,0.05)), border: 1px solid rgba(255,45,85,0.35). Include a title, timestamp, location data with icons, and a full-width action button (red-orange gradient). MEDIUM alert cards use orange variants (#ff6a00).

A list of 'Region Pills' (background: rgba(255,45,85,0.08)). Each row contains a 32x32px icon, a bold location name, and a right-aligned status indicator (Safe/Alert/Watch) with a color-coded blinking dot.

A vertical timeline log within a #130b0e card. Each entry has a 3px solid left-border (color-coded by severity: red for high, orange for mid, #2e1520 for low). Items should be 12.5px font size with muted 10.5px timestamps on the far right.

special_ui_components.description: A notification icon with concentric animated rings.
special_ui_components.prompt: A 40x40px rounded icon container with a linear gradient from #ff2d55 to #ff6a00. Surround with three absolute-positioned concentric 1.5px borders ('rings'). Animate rings using @keyframes ripple: scale from 1 to 2.6 and opacity from 0.7 to 0 over a 2.2s loop with staggered delays (0s, 0.75s, 1.5s).

special_ui_components.description: Vibrant action button with inner glow and drop shadow.
special_ui_components.prompt: Button background: linear-gradient(110deg, #ff2d55, #ff6a00); Box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(255,45,85,0.45); Inner-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.12). Font: Clash Grotesk 700. Padding: 10px vertical. Includes an icon and text with 0.02em letter spacing.
